summary: Floyd County, IN tower constructed by 1935, shown on maps to 1951, listed as not standing and gone; no source describes what remains on the hill.

facts.status_note: Indiana Fire Towers: not standing; FFLA list: gone; Forest Service list marks no tower here as still standing in 2003; removal date not found
facts.agency: Indiana Department of Natural Resources (listed under its fire towers in the Forest Service list); the Indiana Fire Towers author guesses it may have been private

events.note: Constructed by 1935 per Indiana Fire Towers; exact build date not found
Shown on a Floyd County cultural map dated 1936 (the site also dates a map showing it to 1935)
USGS survey disk stamped 1937 set beneath the tower (NGS datasheet HZ2263)
Survey disk recorded in good condition; the Indiana Fire Towers author thinks the tower was probably standing
Tower shown on the 1951 Lanesville topographic quadrangle
Forest Service list marks towers still standing in 2003 with an asterisk; Hickman Hill has none

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Indiana Fire Towers gives 1935 for a map showing the tower in one passage and 1936 for a Floyd County cultural map in another; the story reports both and does not choose.

notes_for_editor: Brief record matches the sources on name, county, coordinates and status (gone). Agency was null and is now taken from the Forest Service list heading. No access, staffing or visit facts found; the Forest Lookouts Hickman Hill page has only a county heading and was not cited. The survey disk may be a remnant worth a look, but its physical state is unknown. Record height and design remain null.
